name: SimTeach
tagline: An AI classroom simulator where teachers practise lessons with simulated students and get feedback.
problem: Teachers learn on real students by trial and error, unlike pilots or doctors who train in simulators.
solution: AI-simulated students respond to a teacher's lesson in real time, and the system gives feedback on clarity and engagement.
demo_moment: Team-described: teach a short lesson and handle questions from AI students.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of AI” among 85 submissions.
High-school students building from their own experience of teachers.

lessons: Borrow a training model from another profession (flight simulators) to explain the idea.
